title: Manipur Actress Soma Laishram Joins Designer Robert Naorem to Showcase State’s Handloom Heritage in Madrid
summary: Manipuri actress Soma Laishram joined designer Robert Naorem’s fashion showcase at the India–Spain Festival in Madrid, highlighting Manipur’s handloom heritage.
image_credit: Image: The closing look featuring Manipuri actress Soma Laishram at the India–Spain Festival in Madrid. Image courtesy: Jaime Recarte.
body:
Manipuri actress Soma Laishram joined designer Robert Naorem’s fashion showcase at the India–Spain Festival in Madrid, highlighting Manipur’s handloom heritage.

Manipur’s handloom heritage and traditional textile craftsmanship received international attention as renowned fashion designer Robert Naorem presented his latest collection at the India–Spain Festival in Madrid, Spain, on November 23.

The showcase, held at MEEU, Estación de Chamartín, was organised in association with the Embassy of India in Spain as part of an initiative to promote India’s rich textile traditions and cultural heritage on an international platform.

A highlight of the fashion presentation was the appearance of renowned Manipuri actress Soma Laishram, who featured as the showstopper and presented the closing look of the collection. Her participation brought additional attention to Manipur’s cultural identity and fashion traditions at the international event.

The runway featured 12 models showcasing designs inspired by Manipur’s distinctive handloom traditions, indigenous textiles, traditional weaves and craftsmanship. The collection reflected an effort to bring together the state’s cultural heritage and contemporary fashion.

The event was directed by Vikram Rai Medhi, with the showcase curated by the North East Institute of Fashion Technology (NEIFT). Photographer Jaime Recarte captured the closing look featuring Soma Laishram.

Through his work, Robert Naorem has continued to promote Manipur’s traditional textiles and handloom craftsmanship beyond the region. His collections seek to introduce indigenous designs to wider audiences while demonstrating how traditional materials and techniques can be incorporated into contemporary fashion.

The Madrid showcase provided an international platform for Manipur’s textile heritage, highlighting the creative potential of the state’s traditional weavers and artisans.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
